# ro_* answers

Synthetic answers shaped like the results of the Real Oficial tools, written from their published descriptions, not captured from a live account. They stand in for the network in tests of the clips lane (issue #164) and the dubbing lane (issue #165). Field names that the tool descriptions do not pin down (`items[]` of `ro_list_translations_and_dubs`, `metrics` of `ro_get_social_analytics`) are assumptions to calibrate against a live answer.
